profile.headline: Sr. Documentum Consultant | Deacon
profile.summary: Highly technical, versatile, and driven IT Consultant with vast knowledge, diverse skill set, and 20 years of experience working as a Documentum Consultant/Architect/Administrator/Developer, Enterprise Content Management Consultant, IT Manager/Consultant, and Web Consultant/Designer/Developer.  Proven track record of delivering results and values for major corporations – LyondellBasell, Marathon, Chevron, ExxonMobil, Kellogg Brown & Root, and Shell.  Innovative, dynamic, and passionate deacon with servant leadership and 22 years of service to the Church and community.
